transformer.name: google-sheets:application-x-struct
transformer.title: Google Sheets (Application X Struct)
transformer.description: Transforms to/from JSon data and Google Sheets ValueRange object

transformerIn.description: A ValueRange or the JSON of one, or JSON rows: a JSON object or array, or a List of JSON objects

transformerOut.description: A ValueRange, or the JSON of one, becomes a List of JSON Strings, one per row or column; another body becomes one JSON String with the header CamelGoogleSheets.splitResults=true, or else a ValueRange
